title: A Great Light
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: John the Baptist was put in prison. So Jesus went to Galilee. He moved to Capernaum, a town beside the lake.
Isaiah wrote long ago, “The people who sat in darkness saw a great light.” Isaiah was talking about Jesus coming there.
Why a light? Think of a dark room that feels scary. Someone turns on a lamp, and everything feels safe. Jesus is that light for the whole world.
p2: In Capernaum, Jesus began to teach, “Repent!” To repent is to turn away from wrong and back to Heavenly Father. It is like stepping from the dark into the light.
When the dark feels scary, whisper, “Jesus is my light.” Then snuggle down, safe and warm.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
